subject: Draft MAP & two-track timeline — confirm owners + blockers
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@blueridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Draft MAP & two-track timeline — confirm owners + blockers

Hi Alice (+ Ben),

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. As promised I've put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with two timeline tracks so you can see a faster pilot-first path and a full-integration path. High level:

- Milestones (proposed):
  1) Pilot setup & smoke tests — dev/staging access, sample dataset loaded (2–3 weeks)
  2) Security & compliance sign-off — questionnaire + evidence, SOC2 narrow-scope review (3–4 weeks, runs in parallel)
  3) Prod integration & performance tuning — VPC peering, logging, autoscaling gates (4–6 weeks)
  4) Go-live & handover — SLA/ops checklist, runbook, training (1 week)

- Responsibilities (draft owners in the sheet):
  - BlueRidge: data export, procurement, security questionnaire owner (Ben)
  - Redwood: integration lead (Marcus), account exec (me), solutions docs (Camila)

- Target close windows: Pilot track — target close (contract signed) in ~5–6 weeks; Full-integration track — ~10–12 weeks.

Key asks from you: please confirm the owners listed on tab 2, and flag any dependencies we missed (esp. procurement lead and SOC2 evidence owner). We noted two potential blockers: 1) timing for your security team to complete the questionnaire, and 2) whether logs need to be pushed to your S3 bucket vs Redwood-managed storage.

I've attached redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx and a short technical agenda for the follow-up sync. If the owners are correct, I'll propose two calendar options for a 30–45 minute technical kickoff next week.

Links: HubSpot deal (BRH-2026-045): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRH-2026-045
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-MAP-BRH

Appreciate a quick confirm on owners + whether Ben or someone from security should join the technical sync.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (Excel), technical-sync-agenda.pdf (PDF)
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@blueridgehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Ortega <ben.ortega@blueridgehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 20:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & two-track timeline — confirm owners + blockers

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear follow-up and the draft MAP. Quick confirmations:

- Owners: Ben will own procurement + security questionnaire coordination (I'll loop in our security SME if needed). I (Alice) will own the pilot product decisions and the internal stakeholder list.
- Security blocker: our security team typically needs 2–3 weeks for questionnaire + evidence once we can get them the sample export and the narrow-scope artefacts — that's the critical path for the full-integration track.
- Logs: we prefer logs to land in our S3 bucket (s3://brh-logs) for now — will that require additional network setup?

I'm OK with the pilot track timeline; target close in early July sounds reasonable. Please include our Procurement contact (Ben) and cc me on the tech sync invite.

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & two-track timeline — confirm owners + blockers

Looping in a couple technical clarifications from my side — thanks for drafting this, Hannah.

1) S3 logs: if BlueRidge wants logs pushed to s3://brh-logs we'll need either an IAM role that allows Redwood to write to that bucket, or a short-lived presigned ingest mechanism. Both are doable; the IAM role + cross-account write is cleaner for production. Can Ben or your infra person confirm which is preferred?

2) VPC peering vs Private Link: the full-integration track assumes a VPC peering connection for low latency and controlled egress. If a Private Link is required by your infra team, that changes the network setup and may add ~1 week.

3) Tech sync: propose two slots next week — Tue 11 May 14:00–14:45 UTC or Wed 12 May 09:00–09:45 UTC. We'll cover integration details, sample payloads, and checklist for the SOC2 evidence pull.

I'll attach a short agenda (technical-sync-agenda.pdf) and a sample IAM policy snippet in the Drive folder for Ben to review.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- Marcus / Camila: please prepare the technical kickoff slides & sample IAM snippet; publish to the Drive folder before the sync.

I've tentatively scheduled the tech sync for Tue 11 May 14:00–14:45 UTC (proposed invite link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/2789-map-tech-sync-proposed). If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite and update the MAP spreadsheet (redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx) with Ben as the procurement owner.

If there are no objections I'll mark this MAP as version v1.0 (draft) and we'll iterate after the tech sync. Thanks again — cc'ing Marcus and Camila for ops prep.

Best,
Hannah
